support_rule: n_f >= 200, context_count >= 20, n_f < N; all measured on TRAIN
frequency_definition: positive gated feature events / TRAIN valid prediction positions
interval_definition: 8 equal-width intervals on raw TRAIN p within supported [p_min,p_max]; left-closed/right-open; last closed
B_rule: NumPy PCG64 seeded permutation of the sorted same support pool into the exact A group sizes; no frequency matching
score_definition: mean over ALL group members of z_f * sum_l ||decoder[l,f,:]||_2; inactive members contribute zero
score_precision: FP64 sparse accumulation, rounded to saved FP32 before argmax and tie detection
decoder_norm_definition: sum of 14 per-layer decoder L2 norms, from frozen A22 state
tie_rule: splitmix64(seed, SHA256 source identity, global block_id, absolute file token offset), modulo number of exact saved-score maximizers
all_zero_rule: same stateless tie rule over all 8 experts; retained, reported, excluded from positive-route coverage gates
low_high_definition: evaluation only: supported TRAIN p <= q10 / >= q90, including frequency ties; not routing interval membership
